brief: Two equal side-by-side square overhead wood textures, neutral diffuse lighting, vertical grain. Left: natural warm red-orange bloodwood with fine straight grain. Right: reddish-brown bubinga with interlocked grain. No objects, borders, text, metal or labels. Illustrative wood samples, not stock-board photos.
processing: Converted original PNG to WebP without resizing or image edits. Four-pixel cell inset at sampling.
limitation: Exact grain, colour, strip order and widths do not define the instrument stock or machining design.
